content: Ligand 1 has SA 4.57 and no aromatic ring at all; ligand 2 is the bis-piperidine sulfonamide. Nothing to cross. But atom 5 is a cyclopropane CH bonded to the protonated amine at atom 4 over a non-ring bond, and it carries no stereo tag, so anchoring there keeps the three cyclopropane carbons and discards the other fifteen atoms - including both stereocentres, which I must avoid as anchors anyway. This is the last blind episode of the generation and the remaining gap is electronic. I have alkyl groups at the pyridine 4-position covered this generation by ethyl, isopropyl and cyclopropyl, but every one of those is a hydrophobic, electron-donating-by-induction substituent of similar bulk, so if they all behave alike I still will not know whether that position wants electron density or simply volume. A 4-methoxy separates them: comparable size to an ethyl, but a strong pi-donor that also lowers LogP and adds an acceptor. Expected product: N-{4-[(4-methoxypyridin-2-yl)amino]phenyl}cyclopropanecarboxamide at about 283 Da.
